spec.headline: Marketing Analytics | Attribution & Incrementality | Client Insights
spec.headline_rationale: This Jobgether MTA role emphasizes measurement methods, integrated data, client recommendations and leadership. Master supports attribution models, holdouts, regression, Python/SQL reporting and teams; pharma data and specialized statistical methods are not invented.
spec.summary: Marketing analytics practitioner connecting attribution, experiments and financial analysis to investment decisions. Analyzed incremental CPA, brand holdouts and data-driven attribution, designed funnel tests, and used regression modeling to evaluate budget opportunities. Built automated reporting across more than ten channels using Python, Databricks, SQL and Funnel.io, alongside Tableau dashboards and client-facing recommendations. Team leadership and agency consulting experience support clear communication of measurement limitations, performance findings and practical options for reallocating spend.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Jobgether MTA Manager US posting. Supported E002/E006/E010/E009/E008/E082/E079/E076/E093. Do not assert pharmaceutical experience, claims data, IQVIA/Veeva, Markov/Shapley/Bayesian methods or clinical privacy compliance absent source. Preserve saved match policy.
spec.tools_rationale: Master-supported data and measurement tools; unverified pharmaceutical platforms, R and cloud warehouse brands omitted.
